correctness.rationale: The quantifiers are explicit: integers \(d\ge0\), \(k\ge d+1\). The proof derives the minimum cardinality, all feasible level sizes, the exact missing-edge count, connectivity after deletion, and the color-preserving orbit correspondence. The included verifier recomputes the first auxiliary counts and sample bouquet multiplicities. Finite checks are presented only as checks, not as the proof of the infinite statement.

value.rationale: The literature itself identifies nonuniqueness of bouquet models as a structural feature. The result upgrades that qualitative observation and the single rank-3 census to an exact stable enumeration for every fixed square deficit, reducing infinitely many topological classification problems to finite bipartite graph counts.
